stock.description: Glory Health Industry Limited functions as an investment holding company, concentrating its efforts on real estate development within the People's Republic of China. The firm's activities are organized into four principal divisions: Property Development; Primary Land Construction and Development Services; Property Investment; and Property Management and Related Services. Its Property Development segment is responsible for the creation and sale of commercial and residential properties. Through its Primary Land Construction and Development Services unit, the company provides essential land preparation, including resettlement initiatives and the construction of fundamental infrastructure and public facilities on land owned by local governments. The Property Investment division manages properties for rental income, while the Property Management and Related Services segment delivers extensive property administration and related offerings. The company caters to individual purchasers for residential units and various corporations and businesses for its commercial properties. Founded in 1994 and based in Beijing, China, the entity was formerly known as Guorui Properties Limited until its name change to Glory Health Industry Limited in July 2022. It operates as a subsidiary of Alltogether Land Company Limited.
